## Specific task description

Task instruction: Set the rectangular silver phone with rounded edges on the dark green phonestand.

Task description: Place the silver rounded rectangular phone lying flat at the lower left of the view on the dark green phone stand in the upper-middle area, so the stand supports it.

Success criteria: The phone is in the support area of the dark green stand, close to the intended position in left-right, front-back, and height. Both grippers are open and the phone is released.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the phone around the upper-middle part of its two long edges, allowing the pads to make full contact with the silver frame while leaving room for the lower end of the phone to seat. The opening only needs to be slightly wider than the phone’s short side.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the phone and watch clearance between the fingertips and table, avoiding pressing only the screen, pushing the phone away, or gripping the tabletop.
- Reorient the phone above the table where there is clearance for both ends to swing. Near the stand, make small adjustments based on backplate tilt to reduce phone-edge impacts against it.
- Support the phone's lower end on the stand's lower support, then gently lean it against the back panel. Confirm fingertip withdrawal space before gradually releasing to avoid slipping or dragging it off the stand.
